# ICP: Regional GPU cloud providers
*v1 — Clouds renting NVIDIA GPUs by the hour whose customers report stalled or slow jobs*

## Must-have
- Regional cloud provider that rents out NVIDIA GPUs by the hour (confidence: validated; source: founder)
- Buyer: the CTO under 50 people; above that, the VP of Infrastructure (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Nice-to-have
- none yet

## Disqualifiers
- AWS-style hyperscalers (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Anti-ICP
- none yet

## Top pains (ranked)
1. Customers' GPU jobs stall or run slow, and the provider can't see why (confidence: validated; source: founder, website)

## Buying triggers
- A wave of customer complaints (confidence: validated; source: founder)
- A newly hired VP of Infrastructure (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Changelog
- v1 (2026-10-27): first version, because of the website and a four-answer interview
